svg.title: G06-no-club-invitation
svg.desc: Arimo outlined design reference. Native iOS controls are schematic. Leila’s account has no active club. Accepted invitations are account-owned rows on Home, ahead of the existing create/join actions. No member roster, approval counts, photos or dates are derived from this row. The largest-text frame shows the top of the same scrolling column. Missing-token changes open the existing signed-in link-entry route without accepting anything.

g.aria-label: A private place for two to six people.
Create a club or open an invitation.
